title: Feynman Circuits Circuit IR
description: Canonical representation of a quantum circuit exchanged through the Feynman Circuits open API. A circuit is a flat list of operations; layout is carried by an integer column on each operation rather than by nesting. Gate ids and their arity/parameter counts are defined in shared/gates.json.

version.description: IR schema version. Only 1.0 is currently accepted.

q.description: Number of qubits. The simulator holds a full 2^q state vector, hence the ceiling.

c.description: Number of classical bits available to measurement results.

qubitLabels.description: Display labels, one per qubit. Omit to accept defaults; if present the length must equal registers.q.

operations.description: Operations in the circuit. Order within a column is not significant; the column field determines placement.

qubitIndex.description: Zero-based qubit index. Must be less than registers.q.

column.description: Zero-based horizontal position on the circuit board.

operationId.description: Optional client-local identifier. Senders should omit it — the receiver generates fresh ids on import, and omitting them makes inline links roughly a third smaller. When present, ids must be unique within the circuit.

targets.description: Qubits the gate acts on. Length must equal the gate's arity: 2 for swap, 1 for every other gate.

controls.description: Qubits that must be |1> for the gate to apply. Must not overlap targets.

antiControls.description: Qubits that must be |0> for the gate to apply. Must not overlap targets or controls.

params.description: Gate parameters in radians. Length must equal the gate's numParams: 1 for p/rx/ry/rz, 0 otherwise.

classicalTargets.description: Classical bits the outcomes are written to. Each must be less than registers.c.
